metadata.description: The Bocche di Cattaro as an engraved Venetian sea chart of 1764: OpenFreeMap's water masked and its coast inked by a wobbling hand; water lines that hug every shore, the land grown out in eight blurred steps whose staircase a Laplacian turns into lines; a narrow hand-coloured band inside the coast; Mapterhorn's relief engraved as stipple as dense as the slope is steep, crossed by form lines found as the drops of an elevation sawtooth; Kotor's walls from OpenStreetMap; soundings, ships, anchors and two roses with their rhumbs kept to the sea; names in the Venetians' Italian, towns in spaced capitals and villages in italic, the bays' engraved letter by letter; on fibred, stained, foxed parchment under a darkened rim and a graduated neatline.
